$comment: Copy this to denylist.local.json and fill in YOUR OWN literals.
denylist.local.json is gitignored and MUST NEVER be committed — it is a list of
exactly the strings you are trying to keep out of the public repo, so publishing it
In CI, provide it via the SCRUB_DENYLIST env var pointing at a file written from a
repo secret. scrub.mjs FAILS in CI if no denylist is loaded — Class B silently off
is the exact way this gate would rot.
Matching is literal (regex-escaped) and case-insensitive unless caseSensitive:true.
